title: A wooden Japanese castle wears an outer coat of white plaster
body: Himeji Castle's surviving complex includes 83 buildings from the early 17th century. Its main buildings use wooden construction with white plastered earthen walls that give them a shared exterior.
takeaway: The material that gives a building its appearance can differ from the one that carries its weight.
visual: layered roofs and white plaster walls of Himeji Castle at twilight

title: India built a tsunami warning centre after the 2004 Indian Ocean disaster
body: The Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services set up a tsunami early warning system after the earthquake and tsunami of 26 December 2004. It uses seismic information and sea-level observations to assess the threat.
takeaway: An earthquake reading can trigger a check, while sea measurements help show whether a wave is actually travelling.
source: INCOIS, Indian Tsunami Early Warning System
